working_definition: Ostial cells of the adult heart (cardiomyocytes forming the ostia, inflow tracts of the dorsal vessel).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Ostial cell of the adult dorsal vessel. There are 20 of these cells per dorsal vessel, forming 5 pairs of ostia along the dorsal vessel. The 4 cells of the posterior-most pair of ostia are embryonic/larval ostial cells that persist in the adult stage; the other 16 cells differentiate during metamorphosis (Lehmacher et al., 2012; Rotstein and Paululat, 2016).

justification: Authors' term (FBbt:00003161 adult ostial pore) is an immaterial space; the label 'adult ostium' denotes the ostium formed by ostial cells, whose cell-level term is adult ostial cell.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: An obliquely oriented, laterally located slit in the wall of the adult heart.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Authors' term; a pore, not a cell.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any ostium (FBbt:00003166) that overlaps some adult (FBbt:00003004).
A specialized cardiomyocyte that is part of an ostium in the wall of the dorsal vessel.
